title: This is Mochi. He sleeps for hours 😴 Cozy Winter Cabin, Crackling Fireplace & Soft Piano for Sleep
description:
This is Mochi. 🐾
He likes to sleep for hours, and tonight he found the warmest spot in the cabin. Snow is falling outside, the fire is crackling and the candles are burning low. Watch him sleep for the next 1.5 hours, in 4K.

Put it on for sleep, study, reading or a slow evening, or as a cozy 4K background on your TV: soft piano, a gentle crackling fire and falling snow, with no sudden sounds.

Tonight's music
0:00 Ember Glow
13:05 Velvet Hush
24:21 Snowfall on the Sill

1:01:01 Slow Purr

Paws & Nooks: cats and dogs napping in the coziest places. Subscribe and nap along.
